source: 54 frozen actual107 packets + independently identified105 closed packet; never mixed sourceIds
variables: x[cell, eyeOwner/part] binary, including retain-clean-canvas label0
sourceMass: integral of measured visible contribution lower/upper over fine samples, divided by actual sample scale squared
massCost: sum_foreground_labels distance(selected whole-cell count, [source lower mass, source upper mass])
dataProxyCost: sum_selected_cell_label (1 - measured lower contribution in that cell); a label mismatch proxy, NOT perception or shape
dataPolicy: min(dataProxyCost) with the same hard constraints; mass is reported, not a hidden weighted term
presencePolicy: each existing eyeId/part with observed certain dominant support must appear somewhere; no target count/shape is asserted
sameCellPolicy: foreground eligibility requires at least one certain dominant source sample of that owner/part in the same cell; a conservative hypothesis, not a universal requirement for strong feature correction
curvePolicy: selected lid cells must contain a path between registered upper-arc endpoint cells; 4-neighbour and8-neighbour are separate hypotheses
curveReference: evaluated registered native skin-ring upper arc, NOT validated native pigment contour; unsupported endpoint => explicit infeasible, never moved silently
relaxedCarrierPolicy: remove same-cell locking within union of the observed owner footprint; source parts must exist but destination depth/visibility/transport remain unverified; mathematical relaxation only
noHiddenCurveAssumption: extra lid components are permitted; all raw source AA fragments are not automatically approved independent features
occlusionScope: source/face visibility supplied by107 inputs; external hair remains a separate actual-depth/coverage stage, not rerendered here
exactArithmetic: frozen binary float inputs converted to dyadic integer costs; zero residual-cost cycle test for mass-policy uniqueness, exact DP for data-policy ties
connectivityAlgorithm: exhaustive simple-path vertex sets, then exact capacitated assignment; min-cost flow alone does not enforce topology
ownerDecomposition: per-owner only after verifying zero shared candidate cells for all55 inputs
notComputed: final RGB or native lid palette

thin path versus strict area bound
